articleTitle: The INTELSAT system in the ISDN era
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Satellites and the ISDN
abstract: A few examples are given of technical areas in ISDN development which are of concern to satellite communications. These problems require action by the satellite community to ensure retention of the medium independency principle in ISDN for satisfactory and balanced network design and operation. The authors also identify candidates for new satellite network scenarios in ISDN, utilizing the particular advantages of satellite based networking to benefit ISDN services to be supported.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: General considerations concerning the integration of satellites into a regional ISDN
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Satellites and the ISDN
abstract: The Conference Europeenne des Administrations des Posts et Telecommunications (CEPT) is studying the feasibility of expanding the EUTELSAT network to a larger number of Earth stations, connected directly to international switching centres (ISC), using CCITT No.7 signalling system, to form part of the European ISDN. The author reviews the feasibility of this concept and investigates several ways which could be used to achieve this, and highlights certain areas of potential difficulties such as compatibility of satellite and terrestrial circuits for certain ISDN services. He considers satellite and network increased integration, and discusses demand assignment and echo cancellation. Satellite/ISDN service compatibility is overviewed.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: Considerations on signalling for an OBP satellite system offering ISDN services
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Satellites and the ISDN
abstract: The author introduces the on-board processing satellite system, presenting its three application scenarios: closed user oriented, ISDN access, and network oriented. The signalling subsystem is described, and the types of signalling and the signalling handling are discussed.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>

articleTitle: Results and experience gained in the participation of ISDN demonstration via satellite
publicationTitle: IEE Colloquium on Satellites and the ISDN
abstract: The author describes the experiences gained by GEC Plessey Telecommunications (GPT) in their involvement with British Telecommunications International (BTI) and COMSAT in the demonstration of integrated services digital network via satellite, using GPT's System X digital telephone exchange. The equipment used is outlined, and several demonstrations discussed.<<ETX xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">></ETX>
